children: Walmart
will begin delivering food orders from Papa John’s International
, expanding its restaurant delivery business and increasing competition with delivery platforms such as DoorDash
and Uber Technologies
Papa John’s
orders will be available through Walmart’s
mobile app and website, with delivery promised within 30 minutes or less, Walmart
said. Customers will also be able to add restaurant food to orders containing other Walmart
products.
The partnership will begin in select U.S. markets in the coming weeks before expanding to thousands of Papa John’s
locations across the country.
The deal marks Walmart’s
third restaurant delivery partnership in recent months and its first with a chain that is not also a tenant at Walmart
stores. The retailer previously launched restaurant delivery with Subway and then
with Dunkin’. Those partnerships initially focused on restaurants located inside Walmart
stores before moving beyond the retailer’s stores.
Walmart’s
move into restaurant delivery builds on its existing fast-delivery network, with orders handled by Spark drivers, independent contractors who deliver Walmart
online orders. The retailer says 90% of Americans live within 10 miles of one of its more than 4,600 U.S. stores.
The strategy is also aimed at combining restaurant orders with Walmart
purchases. About 65% of restaurant orders currently include other Walmart
items, according to the company.
Walmart
has said restaurant delivery is a natural extension of its existing offering, while the expansion could encourage customers to use its app more frequently and increase the size of delivery orders.
The service is part of Walmart’s
express delivery business, which charges a flat fee for orders delivered within an hour or less.

title: Walmart widens food delivery push with Papa John’s partnership
